svg.text: A jump is a wire. The TestState constant "Evaluate" in the True frame IS the abort — there is no goto,
no flag, no exception. The next state comes out of a tunnel and the loop obeys it.
Index Array with an unwired index gives element 0, and String Subset with an unwired offset starts at 0.
Unwired numeric inputs are 0 everywhere in LabVIEW — that is a rule, not an accident.
Build Array only concatenates when "Concatenate Inputs" is ticked (right-click the node). Untick it and you
get an array OF arrays instead of one flat results array, and the wire turns double-thick.
legend: grey = TCP refnum, olive/thick = cluster (error, limits, Result, TestData), blue = enum + I32, orange = DBL, pink = string, green = boolean
tunnel B: "A jump is a wire. That constant IS the abort."
